# vendor/facial

`facial.bin` is the 47 facial/masticatory muscles geometry (BodyParts3D 3.0, registered by OMFAtlas) used by `scripts/prepare-facial.mjs`.

- License: CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan (BodyParts3D, Copyright The Database Center for Life Science). See `public/models/facial/ATTRIBUTION.md`.
- sha256: `7f24687034d706fc08830f617da35f77cb951cd77621a562fa064fa09d5a1b69` (the build verifies it).
- Kept here because the pinned upstream (choxos/OMFAtlas commit c835665a9ade09ee0b993cee6eee1b25b7f7311b) now answers HTTP 404. It stays outside `public/` and is never published; only the compressed packages built from it are.
